name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to pick up the box after it falls, but the current machine does not make it happen. Add a hard Existence of the next pickup action after the box falls, with the correct Precedence chain to ensure the box is picked up after it falls. Also, the current machine does not reward the agent for keeping the box in their hands until the end of the episode. Add a reward for the agent holding the box until the end of the episode, with the correct Precedence chain to ensure the box is held until the end of the episode. The current machine also does not handle the case where the box falls multiple times. Add a hard Existence of the second pickup action after the second box fall, with the correct Precedence chain to ensure the box is picked up after it falls. The current machine also does not handle the case where the agent reaches the exit without picking up the box. Add a hard Existence of the pickup action at the exit, with the correct Precedence chain to ensure the box is picked up before the agent reaches the exit. The current machine also does not handle the case where the agent toggles the switch without silencing the siren. Add a hard Existence of the siren_ringing state, with the correct Precedence chain to ensure the siren is silenced before the switch is toggled.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands the agent to make the very next move the one that picks up the box after it falls, but the clauses only require the box to be picked up after it falls and to be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit. Add a clause that requires the agent to pick up the box on the very next step after it falls, hard, to match the task's wording. The existing clauses are correct.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the box to be picked up after it falls, but the clause RespondedExistence(box_fell, holding_box) hard does not guarantee that the agent picks it up. The correct response is to add a Response clause that guarantees the agent picks up the box after it falls. Additionally, the task requires the box to be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit, but the clause RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) hard does not guarantee that the agent has the box. The correct response is to add a Response clause that guarantees the agent has the box when reaching the exit. Finally, the task requires the agent to toggle the switch when the siren rings, but the clause Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard does not guarantee that the agent toggles the switch. The correct response is to add a Response clause that guarantees the agent toggles the switch when the siren rings.

CHANGES REQUIRED: RespondedExistence(box_fell, holding_box) is redundant because the task requires that the agent holds the box when it reaches the exit, and the other hard rules already imply that if box_fell happens, holding_box happens too. Remove it.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the box to be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit, but the clause R1 does not make it happen; the machine has no final state. Add a hard Existence(holding_box); keep R1.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the box to be in the agent's hands at the exit, but the only clause that makes it happen is the soft RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box). The task is rule-only and hard goal clauses are required, so add a hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) to make the agent pick up the box on the very next step after it falls. The machine accepts the same runs without it, but the correct task requires it.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to have the box in its hands when reaching the exit, but the hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) alone does not imply that the agent must have the box in its hands when the episode ends. The task also requires the agent to pick up the box after it falls, but the hard Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not imply that the agent must pick up the box on the very next step after it falls. The task requires the agent to toggle the switch when the siren rings, but the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) does not imply that the siren stops ringing when the switch is toggled. To fix this, add a hard Precedence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) and a hard Response(siren_ringing, !siren_ringing) to the machine.

the box should be in the agent's hands when reaching the exit
the agent should toggle the switch when the siren rings
